title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad — SOC2 evidence (personal)
Date: 2025-11-04
Owner: Samantha Cho

Quick context: working through evidence collection for SOC2 readiness (Type II scoping for hosted API + Dedicated). This is a personal working doc — rough notes, small TODOs, and follow-ups to push to Confluence and SEC tickets.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Upload KMS rotation proof for customer-prod keys (need snapshot of last 3 rotations) — estimate 1.5h. see SEC-412.
- [ ] Confirm S3 bucket encryption docs: get bucket policy export + inventory of public access flags (ask infra to run s3-inventory job) — @Noah to run by EOD.
- [ ] Vendor review: FastAuth MFA integration docs — collect SOC2 report or AOC from vendor; if missing, escalate to procurement. (Follow-up: SEC-421).
- [ ] Finish sampling logs for incident response process: pick 3 incidents (2025-09, 2025-10, 2025-11) and redact PII — need sign-off from legal.

Notes / findings
- KMS: rotation is automated but evidence format is a CSV export from key-manager. I think we need to normalize timestamps to UTC before upload. Reminder: include key aliases mapping file.
- S3: two buckets flagged in inventory as "public-read" in 2024-12 but remediated. Need a remediation timeline note in Confluence.
- FastAuth: the security contact provided a one-page AOC summary but not full report. Procurement thread in Slack (link above). Action: ask for full AOC or evidence of controls for key management and access reviews.

Meetings / quick calls
- 11:00 with Noah (infra) — run s3-inventory + provide policy snapshots.
- 14:00 sync with Priya: evidence tagging and folder structure for uploads. Decide on Confluence -> Drive mapping.

Action items (assignments)
- Samantha: assemble KMS rotation CSV, normalize to UTC, upload to Drive evidence folder. (SEC-412)
- Noah: run s3-inventory job, attach result to SEC-412 and paste link in slack thread.
- Priya: draft Confluence page skeleton for "Encryption & Key Management - Evidence" and share for review.
- Procurement: request FastAuth AOC or compensating controls document (deadline: 2025-11-10).

Open questions / risks
- Does the SOC auditor accept CSV exports as primary evidence for rotation, or do we need signed attestations? (ask auditor next call 2025-11-06)
- Some older buckets show prior public access — need to capture remediation proof (tickets/PRs). Where to source? (release-engineering or infra).
- Vendor AOC coverage: does FastAuth's AOC cover our specific integration (token exchange)? Need to map control IDs.

Draft messages / copy to reuse
- Slack to infra: "Hi @Noah — can you run the s3-inventory and export bucket policy snapshots for accounts prod/us-west-2 and prod/eu-west-1? Please drop results in SEC-412 and ping me once uploaded."
- Email to FastAuth security: "Request for SOC2 AOC or compensating controls for 3rd-party auth (token exchange). Please include KMS/key handling, rotation frequency, and access review cadence."

Next steps (this week)
- Complete uploads for Key Management and S3 evidence by 2025-11-06.
- Consolidate vendor evidence in a single Drive folder and add index.md (Confluence -> Drive linkage).
- Run quick internal checklist against sample evidence and mark items that need more context before auditor review.

Random notes / scratch (keep here)
- GitHub PR infra#214 adds logging hooks for key rotation events — capture PR diff as evidence.
- Remember to redact all user emails when exporting incident logs.
- Keep single source-of-truth link in Confluence page and reference the Drive folder for raw artifacts.

End of scratchpad.
